title: Story Time at Graddy's Playhouse
seo_title: Story Time at Graddy's Playhouse in Springfield, MO
description: This is a story time at Graddy's Playhouse where you read books about home with Adam Graddy's real estate team and explore the new exhibit. The house has hands-on STEM activities and interactive pretend play spaces, including a real-life kitchen, living room, and backyard. It takes place Friday, December 4, 2026 at 10:30 AM at 438 E St. Louis St. in Springfield, MO, and is held every first Friday of the month.
